verdict.rationale: No evidence shows an in-product AI feature that turns merchant data into insights or suggestions. The closest support needs an external tool: the hosted MCP server, authenticated through the Dashboard, lets your own AI agent query payment statuses and get guided integration suggestions from an IDE. The 'AI-driven' acceptance optimization works automatically in the background and is not presented as user-facing insights. Missing for 10: a native in-dashboard AI insights or recommendations feature, AI analysis of merchant transaction or analytics data, documentation of how suggestions are surfaced to users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
